items.title: AWS Weekly Roundup: AWS Lambda Web Functions, Amazon S3 on the Vercel Marketplace, and more (October 19, 2026)
items.summary: Nothing last week added a new kind of compute. What it did instead was shorten the distance between the code you already have and that code being live.
